title: Extend frontend API client with identity config methods
description:
Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with TypeScript methods for the new identity configuration API endpoints created in task l.7.

Read the existing API client first to understand the established patterns (requestJson helper, error handling, type imports).

Add TypeScript types to react_ui/src/types.ts (OR define them inline in client.ts if the existing pattern prefers that):
- RelationshipConfig: { type, tone, directness, warmth, initiative_level, content_level }
- CharacterProfile: { name, backstory, personality_sliders, humor_style, communication_style, favorite_topics }
- IdentityState: { fixed, slow, mood }

Add API client methods:
- getRelationshipConfig(sessionId: string): Promise<RelationshipConfig>
- updateRelationshipConfig(sessionId: string, config: Partial<RelationshipConfig>): Promise<RelationshipConfig>
- getCharacterProfile(sessionId: string): Promise<CharacterProfile>
- updateCharacterProfile(sessionId: string, profile: Partial<CharacterProfile>): Promise<CharacterProfile>
- getIdentityState(sessionId: string): Promise<IdentityState>
- evolveIdentity(sessionId: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<IdentityState>
- resetIdentityMood(sessionId: string): Promise<IdentityState>

Each method calls the corresponding /api/config/* endpoint with proper HTTP methods and JSON bodies. Follow the existing error handling pattern (ApiError class, status code checking). Do not change existing methods.

If types.ts is in the allowed_write_paths, add the new type definitions there. Otherwise define them alongside the methods in client.ts. Match the existing code style.

Expected files: react_ui/src/api/client.ts (modified), possibly react_ui/src/types.ts (modified)

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client, requestJson helper, error handling, type import patterns)
- react_ui/src/types.ts (existing type definitions, export style)
- chatbot/api/config.py (endpoint paths, request/response shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/src/api/client.ts contains getRelationshipConfig and updateRelationshipConfig methods
react_ui/src/api/client.ts contains getCharacterProfile and updateCharacterProfile methods
react_ui/src/api/client.ts contains getIdentityState, evolveIdentity, and resetIdentityMood methods
All new methods use the existing requestJson helper and error handling pattern
TypeScript type definitions for RelationshipConfig, CharacterProfile, IdentityState are accessible to the methods
No existing API client methods are deleted or modified
No file outside react_ui/src/api/client.ts and react_ui/src/types.ts is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside react_ui/src/api/client.ts and react_ui/src/types.ts
delete or rename existing API client methods
create or modify React component files
